saw.short: London's mystery “Batman” goes viral on TikTok doing good deeds
saw.headline: London's mystery *“Batman”* goes viral doing good deeds
saw.what: Someone in a metal Batman suit is going viral on TikTok across London. His Instagram bio reads: “Tell me your problems, and I will make them go away.” The deeds listed include bringing Freddos back to 5p, handing out fans on the Underground and paying hospital parking fines. Nobody knows who he is.
saw.why: A mystery character plus small, real-world kindness. People share it and guess who's behind the mask.
saw.credit: London's Batman / TikTok via The Tab

saw.short: JADE's “Angel of My Dreams” becomes TikTok's catwalk sound
saw.headline: JADE's “Angel of My Dreams” becomes TikTok's *catwalk sound*
saw.what: Kylie Jenner walked the Victoria's Secret show on 18 Oct to JADE's 2024 single. Since then creators have been filming their own catwalks to it on TikTok, including Jake Shane (1.8m views). The song peaked at No.7 in the UK.
saw.why: A UK pop song from 2024 gets a second life from one runway moment. Anyone can join with a walk.

saw.short: A Glee reboot is reported at Disney+, and the cast is teasing it
saw.headline: A *Glee reboot* is reported, and the cast is teasing it
saw.what: TheWrap and Variety report a new Glee series for Disney+ and Hulu, with Lea Michele said to return. Disney hasn't announced it. Heather Morris posted on Instagram: “Yes ladies and gentle men of women, rumours are true…”, and Chord Overstreet posted “Reunited and it feels so good!”
saw.why: Millennial nostalgia meets cast-led teasing. The fans did the announcing before the platform did.

saw.short: Celebrity Traitors fans think a talk-show booking gives the game away
saw.headline: Celebrity Traitors fans think a talk-show booking is *a clue*
saw.what: With three episodes left, fans noticed James Blunt is booked on The Graham Norton Show on 6 Nov, a week after the finale, and read it as a sign he lasts late. Reddit users keep spreadsheets rating every player's suspiciousness. The castle mural's betrayals went from 14 to 28 after the latest episode.
saw.why: Fans turn small details into evidence. Theory-making is the conversation around the show.

platform.short: Meta lets advertisers set age and gender for each creative
platform.headline: Meta lets advertisers target *each creative*
platform.what: Through its Marketing API, Meta now lets advertisers set the age range and gender each creative suits, not just each ad set. Meta's example: retirement-planning videos for people aged 50 to 65.
platform.why: One campaign can carry different cuts for different audiences, so it's worth making versions on purpose.

platform.short: YouTube now pauses channels that look hacked
platform.headline: YouTube now *pauses channels* that look hacked
platform.what: If YouTube spots unusual activity, it automatically stops the channel from uploading, going live, changing thumbnails or making videos public. Viewers can still watch, and money isn't affected. YouTube says a review typically takes up to 24 hours.
platform.why: A brand channel can freeze mid-campaign. Keep security and login owners up to date.

platform.short: Meta plans a paid Edits Plus tier for creators
platform.headline: Meta plans a paid *Edits Plus* tier
platform.what: Meta's Edits app will get a paid tier with extra cloud storage and AI usage. So far the only listed benefit is 200GB of storage. Price and launch date aren't confirmed; it will start in limited testing.
platform.why: Instagram's editing app is becoming a paid creator tool. The free version still does the job.
